text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Dream Journey's debut race has 
finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――Now then. It's about time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Dream Journey showed no signs of 
nervousness. Calm as ever, with not a 
trace of anxiety on the surface—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to say something as her Trainer to 
help her perform better, yet I can't find 
the words...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......I'm alright.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to greet today 
in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"You have already done a more than 
wonderful job. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Send her off with confidence. ...She'll 
understand it that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic. I was the one who was 
rushing things, getting unnecessarily 
nervous...
choice_data_list: ……I'm praying you can give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go see it, then? The first 
scenery... of our journey—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Oh, here they come.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is there an Umamusume catching your 
eye?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. See that petite girl over there? 
There was a featured article about her 
recently—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, she really looks up to that 
Stay Gold."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Now that you mention it, even the 
vibe seems kind of similar...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't she really tiny...? Is she gonna be 
okay in the race...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. Allow me to see what you are 
capable of."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Exceeds expectations, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Then let us begin—
